modelingNotes: The actual Main Prison outline is OSM way128245373 v4,29August2019. Its two opposite reentrant corners and full orientation are retained in both LODs. No mapped building parts or height exist; original tags are preserved without fabricated survey values.

Alcatraz Federal Penitentiary Q1142661 identifies the prison; this model covers only the principal Cellhouse, Hospital and Administration envelope. Lighthouse, water tower, recreation yard, ruins and other island buildings are separate objects and excluded.

NPS https://www.nps.gov/places/000/alcatraz-cellhouse.htm establishes the1910–1912 reinforced-concrete building and three-story cellhouse. Facade rhythm, barred security glazing, cornice and roof-light positions are proportional interpretations from the individually inspected licensed Commons references, not measured elevations.

Authored body13.4m, parapet14.35m and roof-light ridge15.8m are approximate, inferred by comparing photographed bays with the mapped65×49m envelope. No surveyed height is claimed. Coarse terrain foundation skirts belong to the SDK; roof heights stay local to the model ground datum.

The inspected aerial predates solar installation. NPS https://www.nps.gov/articles/000/structural-upgrades-for-alcatraz-prison-hospital-wing.htm documents contemporary rooftop photovoltaics. The authored panel groups acknowledge that change; their positions, count and dimensions are inferred, rather than an exact1300-panel survey.

Thin grills and roof seams simplify in the low LOD. Security bars are real rods over wall-backed opaque window panels; all windows remain attached to the actual facade. Temporary scaffolding, graffiti, photographic textures and ornamental weathering are omitted.

assets.axes: X east / Y up / Z south
assets.attribution: Open Landmarks; contains © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0; SF Recreation & Parks city brochure and SF Planning official National Register nomination; factual dimensions and opening counts.
assets.licenseScope: CC BY applies to original artistic contributions only; ODbL applies to OSM-derived spatial data. Reference photographs retain their own licenses. Dimension evidence from https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/7387/CoitTowerBrochure_V5?bidId= retains Factual measurements; source documents are linked, not redistributed..
modelingNotes: Actual global OSM way/28824850 (Q1107297) supplies the base outline and original height64m/ele89 tags. Five actual mapped parts supply the shaft outline at50m, low gallery roof5m, north entrance10m, central base12m and entrance surround8m. The exported overall height stays64m; ele89 is not added to geometry height.

SF Recreation & Parks city brochure https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/7387/CoitTowerBrochure_V5?bidId= describes total212ft=64.6176m and18in=.4572m reduction in shaft diameter. The64m OSM value is retained within the published rounding discrepancy; the brochure taper is authored as .2286m radius reduction.

SF Planning official National Register nomination https://commissions.sfplanning.org/hpcpackets/2017-015688FED.pdf section7 pages5-6 confirms eight high belvedere arches, open circular lantern, the north entry flanked by two fluted columns, three glazed sides with four ornamental columns each, pivot round windows and the phoenix/fasces relief. Its included2008 description explicitly gives24 vertical flutes. The182ft description and180ft rising-from-base description are documented alongside the212ft brochure, rather than silently altering source tags.

Individually inspected eligible Commons front photographs by Edward Z. Yang and Christoph Radtke, PerryPlanet distant view and cropped front by dfaulder identify this tower. They show the shallow concave shaft flutes, eight deep upper arches, three small openings above each big arch, higher round-headed crown openings, inset round windows and small balustrades. Images are visual references only, never textures.

Photo-guided inference: the50-58.3m belvedere,59-60.3m triplets and61-63.5m crown openings; wall thickness.65m, inset machine core radius3.15m, reduced small balusters, course seams, window divisions and abstract phoenix relief. The upper gallery and lantern openings are actual air, not dark panels. Lower doors/windows and inset pivot windows use the supported library window finish.

Both LODs retain24 flutes, all eight main arches and upper crown openings, source-registered north entrance and the glazed base. Low omits small triplet perforations, course seams and individual relief/rail detail, retaining the principal architecture. No landscape trees, murals, flag fabric or surrounding road/plaza are included.

modelingNotes: Mapped: OSM way558731934 v24 is the complete terminal footprint; original way24460886 v29 supplies16.1m main body. Clock-tower parts404449724,406710833–839 supply the actual nested plans and43.5/50.5/54.2/60.5/64.5/68.2/70/83.1m elevations. The narrow final83.1m part is retained as the flagstaff, not misread as the clock-face height. Every source version/date/tag is retained.

Resourced: individually inspected Commons San Francisco Ferry Building cropped (CC BY-SA4.0) shows symmetrical long arcades and the tower hierarchy; California06376 (CC BY-SA2.0) shows real open ground gallery arches and open belfry stages. Library of Congress item2013630363 records four22ft(6.7056m)clock dials and a245ft clock tower; mapped nested tiers end at70m plus slender flagstaff83.1m, so those source heights are retained rather than replacing the entire tower with a74.676m block.

Inferred: arcade depth2.1m, bay spacing, engaged upper pilasters, main-roof parapet and stepped cornices are authored from photos. Clock hands and12hour ticks are original texture-free geometry. Both LODs retain the same full plan, genuine ground arch passages, four clocks, open belfries, dome and flagstaff. No ferry pier or adjacent post office is included.

assets.name: Grace Cathedral
assets.axes: X east / Y up / Z south
assets.attribution: Open Landmarks; contains © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0; undefined
assets.licenseScope: CC BY applies to original artistic contributions only; ODbL applies to OSM-derived spatial data. Reference photographs retain their own licenses. Dimension evidence from undefined retains undefined.
modelingNotes: Actual OSM way32946942 and all four building parts are preserved in the source packet. The east-facing westwork towers retain their mapped53m tops, the mapped flèche75m, and the main body28m wall datum. The official cathedral architecture page gives towers174ft/53m and cross247ft/75m above street, and the flèche117ft/35m above the ridge: the roof ridge is therefore about39.6m, not the28m OSM wall mass height. No original source height tag is changed.

https://gracecathedral.org/architecture/ supplies the street datum, concrete-and-steel structure, lead-coated copper roof and seven-bay nave. The saved Commons current east-front and western-chevet photographs were individually inspected; two pre1906 Grace Church stereographs explicitly rejected as another building. The mapped small octagonal part registers the flèche and the two real mapped front-tower polygons determine the east front.

Twin pointed belfry openings on every tower face are real air passages in both LODs. The broad pointed central entrance is recessed behind a thick portal arch; the stairs and door support stay within the saved footprint. Rose tracery, concrete piers, choir/apse, transepts, aisle roofs, clerestory and paired lancets follow the photographs. Dimensions of windows, portal, parapets, buttress caps, spire ribs and steps are proportional photo inferences, not survey measurements.

The street-relative base includes the raised front entry: published tower measurements differ by20ft between street and entry floor. The entry level is approximated at6.1m. The model does not include the surrounding hill, pavement, labyrinth, attached campus buildings or interior furnishings.

Roof panels are closed solids with visible eaves and source-faithful grey metal finish. Four opaque texture-free shared materials are used. Window panels attach to the supporting wall faces; no dark panels substitute for open tower arches. The independently authored low LOD keeps the mapped ground silhouette, both open towers, rose, roof hierarchy and flèche while reducing traceries and omitting fine roof seams/coursing.

modelingNotes: Mapped: OSM way431972186 v19 supplies actual rounded-square base corners, small annex and326m height/61levels. Ten original parts preserve tags/version/date and divide eight tapering shell sectors, the upper flat core and five-level annex. Main skin starts from the union of actual shell/core polygons; the taper finishes on mapped upper core1053143805, rather than a generic circular cylinder.

Resourced: individually inspected Commons Salesforce Tower2020(CC BY-SA4.0) shows continuous rounded corners, white horizontal sunshades and vertical fins; Salesforce Tower Roof(CC BY-SA4.0) shows the open mechanical crown and inset roof. CVU/CTBUH lists326.1m architecture,61above-ground floors and274.6m occupied height. OSM rounded326m is retained. No Salesforce Transit Center or neighboring tower is included.

Inferred: intermediate taper profiles, fin projection.18m, floor-band locations and crown screen spacing are authored from photographs, not new OSM tags. The four source corners and upper core are preserved; the8source roof:height245m bands are coarse taper descriptors rather than245m high literal shed roofs. Curtain-wall skins are opaque structural glass; supported window material occurs only on vertical stone lobby walls. The open crown, inset mechanical roof, mapped annex and326m top survive independently authored low LOD.

assets.licenseScope: CC BY applies to original artistic contributions only; ODbL applies to OSM-derived spatial data. Reference photographs retain their own licenses. Dimension evidence from https://www.skyscrapercenter.com/pdf/building/772 retains Factual measurements; source documents are linked, not redistributed..
modelingNotes: Actual global OSM way24222973 (Q216865) supplies the unchanged source outline, orientation, height260m, levels48, ele5m and1972 tags. Six actual building parts retain raw heights and roof tags: four outer30m skillion strips, inner260m pyramidal part with min_height30/roof_height230, and a215m gabled central wing. The parent roof:height260m is not added to the total height.

Council on Vertical Urbanism/CTBUH primary building record https://www.skyscrapercenter.com/pdf/building/772 confirms260m architectural/tip height,195m highest occupied floor and48 floors. The model retains260m overall, with an opaque white approximation of the aluminum spire above195m and the mapped215m wings. Geometry uses local ground Z0, not the original ele5m tag as a second offset.

Individually inspected eligible Commons photographs by TheWB, wctaiwan and BrokenSphere identify the pyramid, twin vertical mechanical wings, white stepped horizontal floor ledges, narrow vertical window bays and exposed diagonal concrete base struts with true triangular air between members. Photographs are references only and are not textures.

Photo-guided inference:43 repeated occupied facade bands between30m and195m, five lower floor bands, pane spacing (about1.60m in detail), visible ledge projection, vertical window wall positions, base core setback and V-brace thickness. The mapped30m skillion strips describe the sloping structural base envelope; they are represented as exposed braces, not solid wedges that would erase the photographed open ground structure.

The taper follows the actual mapped four-corner pyramid part to the260m apex. Each glazing row is backed by a real vertical, stepped wall band so the approved opaque blue window material is supported over its complete area. The terraced sills carry depth and shadow without textures. Detail adds raised narrow mullions and spire seams. Low authors fewer wider windows and grouped floor rows while preserving bracing, wings, spire and the four-face taper.
